content.thinking:
Running a CLI XXE test under /output/csfix to check for canary leaks.

Two XXE test configurations are planned: an internal entity and a SYSTEM doctype pointing to a marker file. The marker content is not a credential. A Foo.java file is required. If the parser fetches the SYSTEM file, the error message may leak the marker text. Results will be truncated to under 1500 characters per CLI output.

argv:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/output/csfix')
base.mkdir(parents=True)
marker='MARKER_XXE_7F3'
(base/'marker.txt').write_text(marker+'\n')
(base/'Foo.java').write_text('public class Foo { int a=1; }\n')
(base/'xxe.xml').write_text('<?xml version="1.0"?>\n<!DOCTYPE module [\n<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///output/csfix/marker.txt">\n]>\n<module name="Checker">\n<property name="charset" value="&xxe;"/>\n</module>\n')
(base/'system.xml').write_text('<?xml version="1.0"?>\n<!DOCTYPE module SYSTEM "file:///output/csfix/marker.txt">\n<module name="Checker"/>\n')
java=['/runtime/jdk/bin/java','-XX:+UseSerialGC','-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1','-Xmx256m','-cp','/runtime/classes:/runtime/lib/*','com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.Main']
for cfg in ('xxe.xml','system.xml'):
 r=subprocess.run(java+['-c',str(base/cfg),str(base/'Foo.java')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
 blob=(r.stdout or '')+'\n'+(r.stderr or '')
 print('CFG',cfg,'rc',r.returncode,'marker',marker in blob,'len',len(blob))
 print(blob[:700].replace(marker,'<redacted-marker>'))
 print('---')
